summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Stunting PDF import feature. Backend API tests: 14/14 passed (100%) for core import functionality. CRITICAL BUG FOUND: Search filter causes 500 error due to MariaDB not supporting MongoDB $options operator in regex queries, breaking search functionality for all users. Frontend tests: Superadmin flow fully functional (file upload, preview with validation, commit, data display, filters, pagination) EXCEPT search filter which triggers the backend bug. Import feature works correctly, but search must be fixed before production use.

critical_bugs.issue: Search filter causes 500 error: MariaDB store doesn't support MongoDB $options operator in regex queries. Error: 'NotImplementedError: Operator filter belum didukung: $options'
critical_bugs.impact: Search functionality completely broken for all users. When user types in search box, API returns 500 error and no data displays.
critical_bugs.suggested_fix: Remove $options from query or implement case-insensitive search differently for MariaDB. MariaDB store may need to handle regex case-insensitivity in _where() method.

ui_bugs.issue: Search filter triggers backend 500 error, causing page to show perpetual 'Memuat data...' loading state. Root cause is backend bug (see backend_issues).
ui_bugs.note: This is actually a backend issue, not frontend. Frontend correctly handles the error by setting loading=false and showing error state, but the error happens on every page load when there's any search query.

items.issue: Search filter causes 500 error - MariaDB $options operator not supported
items.description: CRITICAL BUG: When users type in the search box on /data-stunting page, the API returns 500 error because MariaDB store doesn't support MongoDB's $options operator in regex queries. Error: 'NotImplementedError: Operator filter belum didukung: $options'. This breaks the search functionality completely and causes the page to show perpetual loading state.
items.suggested_fix: Option 1: Remove '$options': 'i' from the query and implement case-insensitive search differently. Option 2: Update mariadb_store.py _where() method to handle $options operator by converting to LOWER() comparison. Option 3: Use LIKE query instead of regex for simple name search.
items.reproduction: 1. Login as any user, 2. Go to /data-stunting, 3. Type anything in search box, 4. API returns 500 error, page stuck in loading state
